comment: The frequency knobs are configured with dsp::FREQ_SEMITONE as the display base while the audio path uses an octave scale, so the hertz value in the tooltip does not match the pitch produced. The second pulse's duty cycle knob carries the first pulse's name, Pulse 1 Duty Cycle, because configParam was called twice with the same string. The MOD jacks are divided by 10 here where the other chips in this plugin divide by 5.
